title: The Art of Fugue: Contrapunctus 14 (Fuga a 3 soggetti, unfinished)
video_use_ideas: Bach's unfinished last fugue, with the B-A-C-H motif; ends mid-phrase. Use it for legacy or 'work in progress'.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 766 ('Die Kunst der Fuge, Contrapunctus XIX, Fuga a 3 Soggetti', for String Ensemble); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Arnaud Gossart). Edition source: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1885. Mutopia labels this Contrapunctus XIX (older numbering). The score breaks off where Bach's manuscript ends. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
